title: Economic Resilience - Women (stratified) in the Netherlands
descriptions: Dataset collected in December 2023/January 2024 in collaboration between UU/CBS. To study the economic resilience and motivation, opportunity and ability to work among working-aged women 1) with paid work 2) with benefits and 3) without personal income (work nor benefits). A stratified sample was used for recruitment, data includes weights (post-stratification) based on CBS population data of 2021. Items include demographics, family composition and self-reported perceptions towards work, income, household and well-being.
